race.title: Outerspace Group 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: JETZET made a promising start over hurdles at Southwell 3 weeks ago, looking sure to be suited by this longer trip, and he gets the vote. Grande J was a 16-length winner of a point in Ireland in February and makes plenty of appeal, with Hunting Call another to note. JETZET (IRE) GRANDE J (IRE) HUNTING CALL (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Jetzet (10/3), Grande J (4/1), Hunting Call (4/1), Dylans Moon (11/2), Seeyasunday (10/1), Soldiers Trick (14/1), The Gift Shop (14/1), Dukeboxrock (16/1), Looking For Eight (16/1), Lord Des Fresnes (20/1), George's Maze (25/1), Always Stronger (33/1), Good Times Roll (33/1), Upweitjack (50/1)

past_results.ride_description: Tracked leaders on inner, third from 2nd, pushed along before 2 out, ridden and no impression before last, kept on one pace
Tracked front rank, pushed along over 2f out and moved into second, ridden 1f out, no impression on winner and lost a place over 110yds out
Midfield, closed on leaders 4f out, disputed second 3f out, chased winner 2f out, ridden over 1f out, soon lost second, weakened towards finish
